newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows rise in 3-day period -survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows rise in 3-day period -survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. stock mutual funds rose to $206 million for the three days ended March 13, versus $71 million for the two days ended March 10, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said that growth funds rose to inflows of $199 million, reversing outflows of $7 million for the previous period. Growth and income funds posted inflows of $402 million versus $183 million.
Aggressive growth funds posted a rise in outflows to $348 million compared with outflows of $124 million.

Bonds funds recorded outflows of $268 million versus inflows of $291 million. Muni funds posted outflows of $281 million versus inflows of $246 million, and corporate/income/global funds had outflows of $135 million versus inflows of $66 million.
